label: input c at positions 4-6 after a p-initial prefix containing j/k/u
explanation: Very sparse feature (~0.008% of steps). It fires almost only in the original phase (99% of mass), on input token c (86% of mass, lift 26x), at positions 4-6. Its largest activations come when the prefix starts with p and contains j, k or u, usually right before the c (e.g. p g u j w [c], p g e k j [c]). Input c alone gives 80% recall / 86% mass recall but precision under 1%, because most c inputs never activate it. The conjunctive context predicate reaches only F1 ~0.29 (precision 0.30, recall 0.28, mass recall 0.40), so the exact prefix combination that gates it is not captured. It does not fire in the copy phase, at t < 3, or on most other tokens; a few weak activations occur on <DEL> and on tokens next to an active c.

scorecard.summary: Weighted combination of 40 cues. Raise it: orig0=p (+4.88), prev_tok=k (+3.20), phase=0 & in_tok=c (+3.10), recall_idx=-1 & in_tok=c (+3.10), prev_tok=j (+3.08), orig2=u (+3.03). Lower it: correct=1 (-6.36), prev3_tok=- (-2.29), orig1=o (-1.76), t=3 (-1.70).
